title.value: GEO-Bench: Toward Foundation Models for Earth Monitoring
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: GEO-Bench: Toward Foundation Models for Earth Monitoring

extractions.description: This paper introduces GEO-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating pre-trained models on remote sensing downstream tasks. It adapts various remote sensing datasets to a machine learning pipeline, providing code for fine-tuning and evaluating individual tasks. The goal is to stimulate the development of foundation models for better generalization on earth monitoring tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions that Earth monitoring with machine learning plays an increasing role in climate change mitigation and adaptation, as well as climate science.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Earth monitoring with machine learning-based methods plays an increasing role in climate change mitigation and adaptation as well as climate science [57].
